Hi {{first_name|there}},

Welcome to AVGAR.

You're receiving this because you joined the Welcome Series List that feeds the draft Klaviyo flow "JM | Welcome Series (Updated)".

AVGAR builds golf travel and on-course accessories. From recent AVGAR email history (separate campaign evidence), product lines already in market include Links / Dry Bag, UFORIA, Head Cover Clip / Headcover Clasp, and Putt Tuit — use those as catalogue context only; this welcome does not invent a promotion.

In this first welcome step:
1) Confirm you're in the right place for AVGAR gear.
2) Point to the live storefront: https://avgarsport.com
3) Invite one next action: browse the accessories collection that matches what brought you in.

CTA label: Shop AVGAR accessories
CTA URL: https://avgarsport.com  (exact collection deep-link = TBD — not present in exec #63)
